name: Grimdark
means: Fantasy stripped of romance: mud, rust and dried blood, overcast flat light, heavy worn material, no clean surfaces anywhere.
tags: grimdark, dark fantasy, mud, rust, worn armor, overcast, desaturated, grim
prose: a brutal low-fantasy world of mud and rust under flat overcast light, worn heavy material, nothing clean
works_for: video - flat overcast light is among the most stable choices
note: Distinct from dark_fantasy_anime, which is about VALUE (near-black, single accent). This one is about MATERIAL - mud and rust.
